integrity: Analytic determinant and occupancy arguments establish the universal result; the included exact finite checks corroborate but do not certify all parameter values.
scientific_limitations: The signs of intermediate-sized classes can change with the other part sizes; no general intermediate-class ordering or conditional stochastic ordering is asserted. Some historical weighted-enumerator sources remain inaccessible.
title: Degree–leaf covariance obeys a weighted Laplacian law in complete multipartite spanning trees
